## Findings

**Minor.** Confidence high. Owning item P7.4. `packages/task/docs/workflows.md:66` and `:69`. Basis: correctness.

`workflows.md` still tells the worker to run `return --notes … --changed …`, and it still says `dispatch` writes a brief that contains "where to report." `units.brief()` no longer emits `report_api`. `commands/plan-run.md:33` and `references/executor-handoff.md:5` say the integrator passes that handoff file beside `brief.json` and records `unit … return` itself, and the worker must not run `plan.py`. An integrator who follows the workflows page hands over only `brief.json`. The subagent never receives the return shape, and the page still assigns the plan verb to the worker.

**Minor.** Confidence high. Owning item P7.5. `packages/orch/tests/test_contracts_input.py:128`. Basis: boundary coverage.

`test_lifecycle_exceptions_levels_and_json_pointers` sets `provenance.generated_by.tool` to `plan-bridge register`. That string contains neither `report_api` nor `report API`. The assertion still expects only the `plan.rules` warning, so it stays green if the generator-name exemption at `packages/orch/lib/orch/contracts.py:99` is removed. `docs/contracts.md:50` still says lifecycle phrases are allowed in the generator name. A tool string that contains `report_api` or `report API` would then become `LIFECYCLE_LEAK` with this test still passing. Putting `report_api` in the tool field would pin the exemption without a forbidden package token.

**Nit.** Confidence high. Owning item P7.4. `packages/task/docs/workflows.md:77` and `:82`. Basis: project rule (meaning-preserving substitution).

The mandated substitutions were applied literally and no deviation was logged. The roadmap line now says "consider a deterministic dispatcher as a deterministic dispatcher." The bundle line now says "skill an artifact-review skill, when installed." Both are hard to follow as instructions.

**Nit.** Confidence high. Owning item P7.4. `packages/task/commands/dev.md:47`. Basis: correctness.

The sentence is "Use a claim-verification skill, when installed for changing external premises." The sibling edits in `commands/make-workflow.md:24` and `commands/research.md:21` keep a comma after "installed." Here the condition attaches to "installed for changing external premises."

## Questions

None.

## Residual risk

Until P4, `packages/orch/roles/reviewer.md:14` points at role-manifest `skills` and this candidate does not add a manifest. The skill ids are intentionally absent from the orch core, so a reviewer who only has this role text has no skill ids to load.

`report API` is now a substring ban in orch validation and in the bridge superset (`packages/task/bridges/orch/brief.py:33` and `:203`). Ordinary prose or inlined source that says "report API" fails `LIFECYCLE_LEAK` or `BRIEF_INCOMPLETE`. That matches the specified phrase list.

`make-workflow.md:36` still requires the `workflow-craft` matrix after step 1 was hedged with "when installed."

Fixture digests were not recomputed in this pass. `digest-mismatch.json` correctly keeps its old digest after the tool rename. The other execution-input fixtures in the diff change `digest` and the `input_id` suffix together. Recorded orch validation is the evidence that those hashes still match.

Generated adapters, golden files, and `docs/reference/provider-model-roles.md` were not re-read. `render-provider-commands.py --check` is recorded green in `artifacts/P7.4/checks.json`.

## What holds

The new `packages/task/references/executor-handoff.md` matches the specified text and has no managed-block markers. `plan-run.md` still carries `plan.py next|start|log|finish|show`, `Hard risk`, `Owner gates`, `plan.py grant`, and `ROUTE_UNDERSHOOT`. Reviewer copies in the skill, `execution-mode.md`, `review-mode.md`, `methodology.md`, and `workflows.md` are the single pointer line. `reviewer-selection.md` is unchanged. Missing `boundary_allowlist.json` is an empty allowlist in `tests/test_boundary.py:59`. Orch `LIFECYCLE_PHRASES` is `("report_api", "report API")`, and the bridge tuple still adds `plan.py start`, `plan.py finish`, `unit return`, and `task:plan-run`. Schema diffs touch descriptions only. `registrar.md` stays on `register` / `register-review`. Root `CHANGELOG.md` is under `[Unreleased]` / `Changed`. Both items are `in_progress` with start and deviation events and are not marked finished.
